result:
QA-20318 is a PASS overall, but only two of the three Tuesday legs could be evaluated. I ran all three Tuesday legs (UCLA, Viacom, Wasserman), the same set as the 2026-10-20 run.

- **UCLA, University of California, Los Angeles:** 200 of 200 rendered Facebook posts satisfy Reactions + Comments + Shares = Engagements. The Sum row also matches (179,620).
- **Viacom, MTV:** 200 of 200 posts match, and the Sum row matches (10,487,624).
- **Wasserman, Gatorade:** BLOCKED on test data, not a product bug. Jan 01, 2023 can't be selected because of the ~3-year retention window, and the earliest selectable day is Oct 25, 2023 (it was Oct 18 last week). A non-spec probe of Oct 25 – Dec 31 on Facebook returned 0 posts, so there was nothing to check.

No known bugs applied, and none were filed.

The login helper returned before the sign-in redirect finished, so I had to log in a second time. I overrode the post-count regex in the session so counts with commas (like 1,244) are read. Both fixes are noted in the report but not made in the helper files, since this run defers maintenance.

The `browser_run_code_unsafe` tool echoed the login password in its output, so it appears in this run's transcript. The temporary credentials file I generated was deleted.

The report is at `results/2026-10-27/QA-20318-report.md`, and screenshots are under `.playwright-out/QA-20318/`.
